title: Status properties/ForceOverhead
html:
See also Status properties.

ForceOverhead is a status property. Conditions with this property will display the condition over the creature's model when applied and removed.

List of conditions with ForceOverhead

Condition Effects
Acid Reflux
  • Acid damage has spoiled Thisobald's special brew, letting him use  Acidic Regurgitation.
Acid Resistance Aura
  • The fantastical powers of this hallucinatory imp give all nearby creatures Resistance to ⁠Acid damage.
Animalistic Vitality
  • Affected entity regains 2d8⁠⁠Hit Points of health every round when below 60 HP. It also receives an additional 3.5 m (12 ft) of movement speed. [See: Bugs]
Blacked Out
  • Thisobald has overindulged in his own brew. He has a -5 penalty to Armour Class and is Vulnerable to Slashing, Piercing, Bludgeoning and Thunder Damage.
Burning Reflux
  • Fire damage has ignited Thisobald's special brew, letting him use  Fiery Regurgitation.
Buthir's Wrath
  • Buthir is enraged! Strength increased by 4,  Armour Class reduced by 2.

Tactician Difficulty:

  • Buthir is enraged! Strength increased by 4, Armour Class reduced by 2, and has Resistance to all physical damage.
Chain of Tyranny
  • Affected entity has only half its movement speed. When the chain breaks, it takes 8d8⁠⁠Force damage.
Coerced
  • Forced to fight for Nere and takes 1d6⁠⁠Psychic each turn.
  • Ends upon taking any non-Psychic damage.
Cold Reflux
  • Cold damage has chilled Thisobald's special brew, letting him use  Icy Regurgitation.
Cold Resistance Aura
  • The fantastical powers of this hallucinatory imp give all nearby creatures Resistance to ⁠Cold damage.
Deathbringer's Legacy
  • Sarevok is able to use  Deathbringer Assault until the end of his next turn.
  • Orin can use  Deathbringer Assault (Orin) until the end of her next turn.
Eggbearer
  • Carries an owlbear's egg. Its scent will attract the egg's mother.
Electrified Reflux
  • Lightning damage has charged Thisobald's special brew, letting him use  Electrified Regurgitation.
Fire Resistance Aura
  • The fantastical powers of this hallucinatory imp give all nearby creatures Resistance to ⁠Fire damage.
Gaseous Reflux
  • Physical attacks have added gas to Thisobald's special brew, letting him use  Roaring Belch.
Her Voice: the End of All
  • Affected entity's brain is being tortured at the whim of the Absolute. It receives a -4 penalty to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Abilities and takes 1d6⁠⁠Psychic damage at the end of its turn.
Her Voice: Transforming
  • Affected entity's brain is being tortured at the whim of the Absolute. It receives a -2 penalty to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Abilities and takes 1d6⁠⁠Psychic damage at the end of its turn.
Induced Rage
  • The mix of chemicals has thrown the Owlbear into a fit of rage. It is stronger, jumps further, gains a multiattack, and can rupture the earth.
  • The Owlbear receives 4d8⁠Healing every turn if below  105 hit points.
  • The Owlbear has +2 Strength.
Instrument of Loss: Bonesaw
  • The Surgeon can use its implement to  Bonesaw a patient.
Instrument of Loss: Leech
  • The Surgeon can use its implement to  Leech a patient.
Instrument of Loss: Syringe
  • The Surgeon can use its implement to  Inject a patient.
Instrument of Loss: Trepan
  • The Surgeon can use its implement to  Trepan a patient.
Legendary Action: Draconic Fury
  • This great drake will use its  Fire Breath on the next creature that attacks it.
Legendary Action: Draconic Wrath
  • This great drake will use its  Lightning Breath on the next creature that attacks it.
Lightning Resistance Aura
  • The fantastical powers of this hallucinatory imp give all nearby creatures Resistance to ⁠Lightning damage.
Lured
  • The affected entity is attracted to a harpy's luring melody and uses its turn to move closer to the harpy, possibly provoking opportunity attacks from the other harpies.
  • The affected entity must pass a  DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw at the start of their turn or remain lured.
  • Taking damage or being Shoved removes the condition.
Malefic Possession
  • The affected entity acts according to the  Possessing ghost's will and takes 4d8⁠⁠Necrotic damage each turn until it dies or is  Turned.
Mind Mastery
  • Forced to make a weapon attack against one of its allies by a duergar mind master.
  • Ends after the attack, or when hit.
Moderately Inebriated
  • Each sip of his special brew makes Thisobald more intoxicated.
  • He has  Disadvantage on Charisma and Dexterity Checks, and has started hallucinating imps.
Murderous Strikes
  • After performing four attacks, Sarevok will have embodied Bhaal enough to use  Deathbringer Assault.
  • After performing five attacks, Orin will have embodied Bhaal enough to use  Deathbringer Assault (Orin)
Owlbear's Rage
  • The owlbear is enraged! Strength and Constitution increased by 2, and gained  12 temporary hit points.
  • The owlbear has resistance to all ⁠Physical damageTTactician
Owlbear's Rage
  • The owlbear is enraged! Strength and Constitution are increased by 2.
  • The owlbear gains  12 temporary hit points.
Poison Resistance Aura
  • The fantastical powers of this hallucinatory imp give all nearby creatures Resistance to ⁠Poison damage.
Polma's Wrath
  • Polma is enraged! Strength increased by 4, Armour Class reduced by 2.
Profoundly Intoxicated
  • Thisobald is on the verge of passing out from his heavy drinking.
  • He has  Disadvantage on Charisma and Dexterity Checks, and his hallucinations continue.
Recovering
  • Thisobald has had enough of his own concoctions - for now. Soon the numbness will set in once more, and the cycle will start all over again.
Regeneration
  • The Wood Woad regains 10⁠⁠Hit Points if it walks through a vine surface, unless it recently took ⁠Fire damage.
Resistant to Acid Damage
  • Acid damage against this entity is halved.
Resistant to Cold Damage
  • Cold damage against this entity is halved.
Resistant to Fire Damage
  • Fire damage against this entity is halved.
Resistant to Lightning Damage
  • Lightning damage against this entity is halved.
Resistant to Poison Damage
  • Poison damage against this entity is halved.
Rotten Reflux
  • Necrotic damage has spoiled Thisobald's special brew, letting him use  Rotting Regurgitation.
Soul Branding
  • Creature's movement speed is increased by 1.5 m (5 ft), and its next weapon attack deals an additional 2d4 + 1⁠⁠Fire damage. This condition ends upon landing a successful weapon attack.
Sovereign's Protection
  • Protected from the myconids' mushroom traps by the Sovereign's spore sac.
  • Mushroom traps like Bibberbang are temporarily disabled for the affected creature, enabling safe passage.
Spider Queen's Wrath
  • Creature is enraged! Gained an additional attack per turn. Strength increased by 2,  Armour Class reduced by 1.
  • Tactician Difficulty: Creature is enraged! Gains an additional attack per turn. Strength is increased by 2 and has Resistance to physical damage.
Strength Drain
  • A shadow has drained the affected entity's Strength by 3.
Surgeon's Chosen
  • Carrying the implement requested by the Surgeon to complete its surgery.
  • The nurse gains a +4 bonus to Armour Class.
Threat Assessment
  • Grym has locked on to a new target.
Toxic Reflux
  • Poison damage has contaminated Thisobald's special brew, letting him use  Venomous Regurgitation.
Vampire Regeneration
  • The vampire regains  20 hit points at the start of its turn, unless it is in sunlight, or has taken radiant damage or damage from holy water.
Volatile Blood
  • This creature takes 1d6⁠⁠Necrotic damage each turn and Detonate upon death.
Weapon Dropped!
  • An enemy has made you drop your weapon to the ground, similar to  Disarmed.
Weapon Stolen!
  • An enemy has taken your weapon.
